metadata.case_name: LEE KWAN TONG v. LIU YEE LIM AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: Telco Collector (employed by Hong Kong Security Limited / Securicor Hong Kong Limited)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Office duties with same employer after return to work; later employed as courier, messenger, hawker and vehicle attendant
plaintiff.education_level: probably educated up to no more than secondary school level

source: fracture shaft of the right femur

injuries.description: compound fracture of the right tibia
source: compound fracture of the right tibia

source: the tibial fracture had healed with a 4 cm. shortening resulting in a pelvic tilt

injuries.description: ligament laxity in the right knee
source: ligament laxity in the right knee

source: Mild to moderate osteoarthritis had occurred causing pain and reduced function.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the knee or lower leg

manifestations.description: needed resting after walking for about 20 minutes (later 40 - 60 minutes)
muscle wastage due to reduced use of the right leg
right knee crunched as the Plaintiff walked
scars on the leg (scars healed) which prevent wearing shorts
reduced function of the right leg

treatments_received: internal plating for the fractured right femur
external fixation for the right tibia
physiotherapy treatment (lasting for about a year)
readmissions for adjusting the alignment of the fracture tibia by adjusting the external fixator

losses.description: Disability affecting general activities and enjoyment of life; reduced function of the right leg (limp, need to rest after walking)
Scars on the right leg preventing the Plaintiff from wearing shorts
Needs to rest after walking for 40 - 60 minutes; walks with a limp

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Can no longer take up sports and outdoor activities such as swimming, ball games, hiking and exercising
Unable to continue as a security guard/driver and had to change to office duties; loss of previous employment role
